title: Book One · Chapter 141: The Hot Months
story:
During the hot months, Ronan keeps the street pictures between two boards. Ronan opens them on Sundays. He touches the corners. They are dry. Then he ties the boards again. The little cat picture stays on their own wall for a while. Mum likes seeing the cat on their wall. This cat picture does not need fish.

School is busy. Ronan can read some words quickly. He stops at others and marks them with his pencil. There are fewer marks than before. Sometimes that pleases him. Sometimes Mei finishes before him. He looks at her page. His hand holds the pencil tightly.

Leo has a new game with another boy at break. It uses a small ball and a wall. Ronan joins them some days. On other days he reads under the tree with Mei and two girls. Ronan and Leo still play together. They can join different groups on some days.

Mr Qiu opens the grey table each morning. Mrs Lan keeps the clear line near her gate. They agreed to keep the path clear in the rain. They still keep that agreement now. They keep the path clear on hot days too. When the sun turns the table too warm, Mr Qiu moves the books back a little. He does not move the table into the path.

One afternoon Ronan comes home to find him asleep in his chair. The old man's hand is open on his knee. A woman stands outside with a coin.

Ronan almost reaches for a pencil to sell her. Then he touches Mr Qiu's sleeve instead.

“A customer.”

Mr Qiu wakes with a little jump. “I was counting.”

“With your eyes shut?”

“Very small numbers.”

The woman laughs. Mr Qiu sells her the pencil himself. Later he begins closing the table for a short rest after lunch. He puts the time on his sign. He rests for an hour, then opens the table again. Customers can come before or after his rest.

Mum makes three more blue bags. Two people try the handles. Then they buy a bag each. The third stays beside her sewing things. She keeps her cloth and paper in it. She puts the money in her own work envelope first. She gives some to the household money. That helps pay for their food and home.

“What is the rest of the money for?” Ronan asks.

“More cloth. Better thread. And something I choose.”

“The blue dress?”

“Perhaps. I have not forgotten.”

He has not forgotten either. He draws his own idea for the dress. Mum sees it. “Why are there seven buttons on one sleeve?” she asks. Ronan says it is a very important sleeve.

The hot summer is nearly over. New exercise books appear at Mr Qiu's table. Ronan chooses a plain one for the new term. He writes his name on the first page himself. He does not ask Mum to guide his hand.

He checks the spelling on the cover. Then he closes the book. One letter is too close to the edge. He decides to leave it. It is his name, still easy to read. In other years, he kept writing his name again. He used more paper to get it right. This time he leaves it. This book will have sums, mistakes, and words in it soon enough.

Then he takes a second sheet and writes the names of the street pictures. They have not worked on the school plan this summer. Miss Wu has said they can return to it when the new term begins.

Ronan puts the list in the new book. He is nearly nine now. His feet have grown. His sleeves are short. He holds the picture boards under his arm. He can carry them more easily now. The pictures inside it are the same size. There is more he wants to put beside them.

重点表达：term＝学期；household＝家庭日常的；guide＝引导。

情节提示：envelope＝信封；thread＝线；spelling＝拼写。

理解：1. Mr Qiu 怎样安排自己的午休？2. Mum 为什么保留一部分工作收入？
